summary: Invesco Commercial Real Estate Finance Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) to declare monthly distributions for April 2026 across its multiple common stock classes (S, S-1, D, D-1, I, E, F). Gross distribution is $0.1600/share, with net amounts varying by class after stockholder servicing fees. The distributions are payable in cash or reinvested via the distribution reinvestment plan to holders of record on April 30, 2026, paid on or about May 13, 2026. This is a routine periodic distribution announcement, not a special situation.
